a1.task: Stell dich vor: Sag deinen Namen, wie alt du bist und woher du kommst.
a1.question: Can you introduce yourself?
a1.sample: Hello, my name is Anna. I am twenty-five years old and I am from Germany.

a1.question: Tell me about your family.
a1.sample: I have a big family. I have one brother and two sisters. My parents live in Berlin.

a1.task: Sag, was du gern isst und trinkst.
a1.question: What do you like to eat and drink?
a1.sample: I like pizza and pasta. I drink coffee in the morning and water every day.

a1.task: Beschreibe dein Zimmer oder deine Wohnung.
a1.question: Describe your room or your flat.
a1.sample: My flat is small. There is a kitchen, a bathroom and one bedroom. My bedroom is blue.

a1.task: Erzähle, was du jeden Tag machst.
a1.question: What do you do every day?
a1.sample: I get up at seven. I have breakfast and then I go to work. In the evening I watch TV.

a1.task: Sag, welche Farben und Dinge du magst.
a1.question: What is your favourite colour and why?
a1.sample: My favourite colour is green. I like green because I love nature and the forest.

a2.question: What did you do last weekend?
a2.sample: Last weekend I visited my friends. On Saturday we went to the cinema and on Sunday I stayed at home.

a2.question: Tell me about your last holiday.
a2.sample: Last summer I went to Spain with my family. We stayed in a hotel near the beach and the weather was great.

a2.task: Bestelle im Restaurant ein Essen und ein Getränk.
a2.question: Good evening! What would you like to order?
a2.sample: I'd like the chicken with salad, please. And could I have a glass of orange juice?

a2.task: Erkläre jemandem den Weg von deiner Wohnung zum Supermarkt.
a2.question: How do I get to the supermarket from your home?
a2.sample: Go straight on and turn left at the traffic lights. The supermarket is next to the bank.

a2.task: Erzähle von deinen Plänen für nächsten Monat.
a2.question: What are your plans for next month?
a2.sample: Next month I'm going to start a new course. I'm also going to visit my grandparents.

a2.task: Beschreibe, was du gern einkaufst und wo.
a2.question: Where do you like to go shopping?
a2.sample: I like shopping at the market because the vegetables are fresh and cheap.

b1.task: Erzähle von einer besonderen Erfahrung (Present Perfect/Past).
b1.question: What is the most interesting place you have ever visited?
b1.sample: The most interesting place I've ever visited is Iceland. I went there two years ago and I saw the northern lights.

b1.task: Sag deine Meinung zum Homeoffice und begründe sie.
b1.question: Do you think working from home is a good idea?
b1.sample: In my opinion, working from home is a good idea because you save time. However, I sometimes miss my colleagues.

b1.task: Beschreibe deinen Beruf oder deine Ausbildung.
b1.question: Can you tell me about your job or studies?
b1.sample: I work as a nurse in a hospital. I'm responsible for patients and I often work at night.

b1.task: Was würdest du tun, wenn du im Lotto gewinnen würdest?
b1.question: What would you do if you won the lottery?
b1.sample: If I won the lottery, I would travel around the world and buy a small house by the sea.

b1.task: Beschreibe ein Problem, das du gelöst hast.
b1.question: Tell me about a problem you solved recently.
b1.sample: Recently my car broke down. I called a mechanic and he fixed it, so I was only a bit late for work.

b1.task: Empfiehl einen Film oder ein Buch und erkläre, warum.
b1.question: Can you recommend a film or a book?
b1.sample: I would recommend a film that I saw last month. Although it is quite long, the story is really exciting.

b2.task: Nenne Vor- und Nachteile von sozialen Medien.
b2.question: What are the advantages and disadvantages of social media?
b2.sample: On the one hand, social media helps us stay in touch. On the other hand, it can be addictive and spread fake news.

b2.task: Stell ein Produkt oder Projekt kurz vor, wie in einer Präsentation.
b2.question: Could you briefly present a project you have worked on?
b2.sample: Today I'd like to talk about a project I led last year. First, I'll explain the goal, and then I'll show you the results.

b2.task: Berichte, was dir jemand kürzlich erzählt hat (indirekte Rede).
b2.question: What did a friend or colleague tell you recently?
b2.sample: My colleague told me that she was going to move to Canada and that she had already found a new job.

b2.task: Was würdest du anders machen, wenn du die Zeit zurückdrehen könntest?
b2.question: Is there anything you would have done differently in the past?
b2.sample: If I had known how useful English is, I would have started learning it much earlier.

b2.task: Diskutiere: Sollten Autos aus Innenstädten verbannt werden?
b2.question: Should cars be banned from city centres?
b2.sample: I'm in favour of it, because the air would be cleaner. Having said that, we would need better public transport.

b2.task: Beschreibe eine Gewohnheit, die du aufgegeben hast oder aufgeben willst.
b2.question: Is there a habit you have given up or want to give up?
b2.sample: I gave up drinking sugary drinks last year. To be honest, it was harder than I thought, but I feel much better now.

c1.task: Nimm differenziert Stellung: Macht Technologie uns produktiver?
c1.question: Does technology make us more productive?
c1.sample: To a certain extent, it does. Having said that, constant notifications arguably undermine our ability to focus.

c1.task: Verhandle diplomatisch: Du möchtest eine Gehaltserhöhung.
c1.question: Why do you think you deserve a pay rise?
c1.sample: I was wondering if we could discuss my salary. Over the past year I've taken on additional responsibilities and exceeded my targets.

c1.task: Beantworte mit der STAR-Methode: eine schwierige Situation im Team.
c1.question: Tell me about a time you had to deal with a conflict in a team.
c1.sample: At my previous job, two colleagues disagreed about priorities. I organised a meeting, we weighed up the options and, as a result, we met the deadline.

c1.task: Erkläre ein komplexes Thema aus deinem Fachgebiet für Laien.
c1.question: Could you explain something complex from your field in simple terms?
c1.sample: Essentially, it's like a recipe: if you change one ingredient, the whole result changes, so precision is crucial.

c1.task: Wäge ab: Sollte die Vier-Tage-Woche Standard werden?
c1.question: Should the four-day week become the norm?
c1.sample: While it is true that it could boost wellbeing, I have my reservations about whether it would suit every industry.

c1.task: Beschreibe formell und dann umgangssprachlich, wie dein Tag war.
c1.question: How was your day? Answer once formally and once casually.
c1.sample: Formally: My day was rather demanding but productive. Casually: Honestly, I'm knackered, but it was a good day.

c2.task: Analysiere ironisch, aber höflich, ein alltägliches Ärgernis.
c2.question: What is something that annoys you in everyday life?
c2.sample: I'm absolutely delighted, of course, whenever my train is cancelled at the last minute – it really adds a certain thrill to my mornings.

c2.task: Argumentiere vielschichtig und benenne einen möglichen Denkfehler.
c2.question: Is it fair to say that young people read less than ever?
c2.sample: It is often claimed that they read less, but this rests on the assumption that only books count. On balance, they arguably read more, just differently.

c2.task: Erkläre eine kulturelle Besonderheit Deutschlands einem Briten.
c2.question: What is a German custom a British person might find odd?
c2.sample: Not uncommonly, Brits are baffled by our strict Sunday quiet. Mind you, once you get used to it, it's rather a blessing in disguise.

c2.task: Beschreibe den Ton eines Textes oder einer Rede, die dich beeindruckt hat.
c2.question: Describe the tone of a speech or text that impressed you.
c2.sample: The speech struck a wry, understated tone; rather than preaching, it conveyed its message through subtle irony and carefully chosen anecdotes.

c2.task: Spiele mit Mehrdeutigkeit: Erkläre ein Wortspiel oder einen Witz.
c2.question: Can you explain a pun or a joke you like?
c2.sample: I like the one about the banker who lost interest – it works because interest means both curiosity and money earned on savings.

c2.task: Halte eine kurze, rhetorisch ausgefeilte Rede zu einem Thema deiner Wahl.
c2.question: Give a short, persuasive speech on a topic of your choice.
c2.sample: We came, we saw, we scrolled. Who among us hasn't lost an evening to a screen? It's time we took our attention back.
